measurement.method: Current defaults: PB_CONFIG_INIT, PB_MAX_BATCH and directional budgets from production headers, without forced includes. Old baseline: current same source with isolated batch32/region64MiB overrides and explicit 1queue/32slots/ring64/128KiB budgets. Depth control: same old binary, 1queue/128slots/ring128/batch32. Adjacent profiles, reverse order every round. Actual DLL queue bodies and shared core, real Windows events/SRW locks, pinned user/hosted-peer threads (2 per queue), immediate completion/recycle, pre-touched buffers and exact ordered 16-byte markers per object. No full payload copy, SYS/NDIS callbacks, crypto or network; directions measured separately. SetEvent/wait call counts are not context switches.
